name: marketingskills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the marketingskills capability.

prompts.name: seo_content_creation
prompts.template: Create an SEO-optimized article on {topic} that targets the following keywords: {seo_keywords}. The article should be engaging and drive conversions.
prompts.use_case: Enhancing website conversion rates through optimized content and UX adjustments

prompts.name: conversion_rate_improvement
prompts.template: Analyze the following website data and suggest actionable strategies to improve the conversion rate: {website_data}.
prompts.use_case: Automating copywriting tasks for marketing campaigns targeting specific audiences

prompts.name: growth_strategy_development
prompts.template: Develop a growth strategy for a company in the {industry} sector focusing on metrics: {growth_metrics}.
prompts.use_case: Improving SEO rankings by analyzing keywords and on-page content

prompts.name: marketing_campaign_copy
prompts.template: Write persuasive marketing copy based on this brief: {content_brief}, aimed at achieving these goals: {marketing_goals}.
prompts.use_case: Building growth strategies for startups to accelerate user acquisition

prompts.name: analytics_report_summary
prompts.template: Provide a summary and insights from this marketing analytics data: {analytics_data}.
prompts.use_case: Generating analytics reports to monitor and adapt marketing performance
